|errata_history=This is the original (version 1 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Steadfast (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-steadfast-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/steadfast.png Holotable commit c241f88 “vset14”], no mark). Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 2 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While alone at a battleground, adds Force icons to equalize them for both sides here. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Steadfast (Errata)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-steadfast-20220531.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/steadfast.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], no mark). Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 2 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While alone at a battleground, adds Force icons to equalize them for both sides here. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Steadfast (Errata 2)]], 10 August 2022): Players Committee card image, 10 August 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-steadfast.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/78c6cd9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/steadfast.png Holotable commit 78c6cd9 “Set 19 plus errata and fixes”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 2 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While alone at an [Episode VII] system, adds Force icons to equalize them for both sides here. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' “While alone at a battleground” became “While alone at an [Episode VII] system”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
|hatnote=Other versions of this card: [[Steadfast (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Steadfast (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
